- [IARC.7.4] `libprotobuf-c` — the DSC artefact loader
  ([RDSC.12]) decodes protobuf atom bodies. Scope is
  artefact load only per [IARC.1.15]; no other libds module
  may use it. Atom bodies ([RDSC.4.5]) are stored uncompressed, so libds
  carries no decompressor and no `-lz` dependency —
  `libprotobuf-c` is the sole non-vendored load-path lib.
